title: Stephen retorted
html_source:
Although Stephen sneered earlier in chap 9, his verbs have upped the ante compared to John Eglington’s reflecting Stephen’s excitement about the debate.

‘Stephen said with tingling energy’

‘Stephen retorted’

This plain language directing the action is in significant contrast to the dense allusory environment and the spindles of Stephen’s thought. It parallels stage directions.

radition of three centuries? John Eglinton's carping voice asked. Her ghost at least has been laid for ever. She died, for literature at least, before she was born.

anchor.suffix: , sixtyseven years after she was born. She saw him into and out of the world. She took his first embraces. She bore his children and she laid pennies on his eyes to keep his eyelid
